dyadID.Description: ID number for each dyad. Same generation dyads are in range 1001-1030 and intergenerational dyads are in range 2001-2031.

pID1.Description: Participant ID of one dyad member. Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

pID2.Description: Participant ID of second dyad member. Younger adults were assigned IDs in ranges 101-146 or 201-245 and older adults were assigned IDs in range 301-331.

Perc_simultaneous_1.Description: Percentage of 5 min period of first joint drawing where dyad members drew simultaneously in increments of 10%, divided by 10 for a score between 0 and 10. 0 reflects turn-taking only and 10 reflects simultaneous drawing only.

Perc_simultaneous_2.Description: Percentage of 5 min period of second joint drawing where dyad members drew simultaneously in increments of 10%, divided by 10 for a score between 0 and 10. 0 reflects turn-taking only and 10 reflects simultaneous drawing only.
